plugin.name: StatusBarInset
plugin.description: Returns the real, on-device status bar / top-safe-area inset height via native APIs (Android: WindowInsetsCompat; iOS: UIView.safeAreaInsets), so JS-side layout code (e.g. AdMob banner offset) can match it exactly instead of guessing a fixed constant or inferring it from unreliable JS-only heuristics. JS callers should feature-detect (window.cordova.plugins && window.cordova.plugins.statusBarInset) and call the method matching the current platform (Android: getInsetTopDp, iOS: getInsetTopPt).
